campaign_quests (\n      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n      campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n      title TEXT NOT NULL,\n      status TEXT NOT NULL,\n      milestones_json TEXT NOT NULL,\n      completed_json TEXT NOT NULL\n    );\n\n    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_campaign_quests_campaign ON campaign_quests(campaign_id);\n  SQL\n\n  # Yields a single shared SQLite connection while serializing access with a\n  # global mutex. Using one connection avoids connection-pooling edge cases and\n  # keeps the implementation deterministic.\n  def self.db\n    DB_MUTEX.synchronize { yield DATABASE }\n  end\n\n  def self.schema_initialized?\n    db { |d| d.get_first_value(\"SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='users'\") } ? true : false\n  end\n\n  def self.initialize_schema!\n    db { |d| d.execute_batch(SCHEMA_SQL) }\n  end\n\n  def self.reset!\n    db do |d|\n      %w[combat_conditions combat_sessions compendium_monsters compendium_items users\n         campaigns campaign_characters campaign_events campaign_quests schema_meta].each do |table|\n        d.execute(\"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #{table}\")\n      end\n      d.execute_batch(SCHEMA_SQL)\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.status\n    {\n      driver: 'sqlite',\n      schema_version: Config::SCHEMA_VERSION,\n      initialized: schema_initialized?\n    }\n  end\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Combat state: sessions, initiative, and conditions\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Combat\n  def self.create_session(payload)\n    parsed = parse_combat_session(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless parsed\n\n    session_id, order = parsed\n    order_json = JSON.generate(order)\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = ?', session_id)\n      next [:invalid] if existing\n\n      d.execute('INSERT INTO combat_sessions (id, round, turn_index, order_json) VALUES (?, 1, 0, ?)', [session_id, order_json])\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => session_id,\n        'round' => 1,\n        'turn_index' => 0,\n        'active' => order[0],\n        'order' => order\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.add_condition(session_id, payload)\n    target = payload['target']\n    condition = payload['condition']\n    duration = payload['duration_rounds']\n\n    return [:invalid] unless target.is_a?(String) && !target.empty? &&\n                             condition.is_a?(String) &&\n                             duration.is_a?(Integer) && duration > 0\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT order_json FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = ?', session_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      order = JSON.parse(row[0])\n      next [:invalid] unless order.any? { |c| c['name'] == target }\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO combat_conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining_rounds) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [session_id, target, condition, duration]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'target' => target,\n        'conditions' => fetch_conditions_for_target(d, session_id, target)\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  # Conditions decrement at the *start* of a target's turn and are removed\n  # when their remaining duration drops to zero. The response echoes the full\n  # condition map so callers can see every combatant's state.\n  def self.advance_turn(session_id)\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT round, turn_index, order_json FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = ?', session_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      round, turn_index, order_json = row\n      order = JSON.parse(order_json)\n      count = order.length\n\n      new_turn_index = (turn_index + 1) % count\n      new_round = round + (new_turn_index == 0 ? 1 : 0)\n\n      active_name = order[new_turn_index]['name']\n\n      d.execute('SELECT id, remaining_rounds FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ? AND target = ?', [session_id, active_name]).each do |cond_id, remaining_rounds|\n        new_remaining = remaining_rounds - 1\n        if new_remaining <= 0\n          d.execute('DELETE FROM combat_conditions WHERE id = ?', cond_id)\n        else\n          d.execute('UPDATE combat_conditions SET remaining_rounds = ? WHERE id = ?', [new_remaining, cond_id])\n        end\n      end\n\n      d.execute('UPDATE combat_sessions SET round = ?, turn_index = ? WHERE id = ?', [new_round, new_turn_index, session_id])\n\n      conditions = order.each_with_object({}) { |c, h| h[c['name']] = [] }\n      d.execute('SELECT target, condition, remaining_rounds FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY id', session_id).each do |target, condition, remaining_rounds|\n        conditions[target] ||= []\n        conditions[target] << { 'condition' => condition, 'remaining_rounds' => remaining_rounds }\n      end\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => session_id,\n        'round' => new_round,\n        'turn_index' => new_turn_index,\n        'active' => order[new_turn_index],\n        'conditions' => conditions\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.parse_combat_session(payload)\n    session_id = payload['id']\n    return nil unless session_id.is_a?(String) && !session_id.empty?\n\n    combatants = payload['combatants']\n    return nil unless combatants.is_a?(Array) && !combatants.empty?\n\n    parsed = combatants.map do |c|\n      return nil unless c.is_a?(Hash) &&\n                        c['name'].is_a?(String) && !c['name'].empty? &&\n                        c['dex'].is_a?(Integer) &&\n                        c['roll'].is_a?(Integer)\n\n      { name: c['name'], score: c['roll'] + c['dex'], dex: c['dex'] }\n    end\n\n    parsed.sort_by! { |c| [-c[:score], -c[:dex], c[:name]] }\n    order = parsed.map { |c| { 'name' => c[:name], 'score' => c[:score] } }\n\n    [session_id, order]\n  end\n  private_class_method :parse_combat_session\n\n  def self.fetch_conditions_for_target(d, session_id, target)\n    d.execute(\n      'SELECT condition, remaining_rounds FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ? AND target = ? ORDER BY id',\n      [session_id, target]\n    ).map do |condition, remaining_rounds|\n      { 'condition' => condition, 'remaining_rounds' => remaining_rounds }\n    end\n  end\n  private_class_method :fetch_conditions_for_target\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Compendium: monsters and items\n# 'INSERT INTO compendium_monsters (slug, name, cr, armor_class, hit_points, tags_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:slug], data[:name], data[:cr], data[:armor_class], data[:hit_points], self.read_item(slug)\n    return [:invalid] unless slug.is_a?(String) && !slug.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT name, type, rarity, cost_gp FROM name,\n        'type' => type,\n        'rarity' => rarity,\n        'cost_gp' => cost_gp\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_monster(payload)\n    return nil unless                    armor_class.is_a?(Integer) &&\n                      hit_points.is_a?(Integer) &&\n                      tags.is_a?(Array) &&\n                      tags.all? { |t| t.is_a?(String) payload['rarity']\n    cost_gp = payload['cost_gp']\n\n    return nil unless slug.is_a?(String) && !slug.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      type.is_a?(String) && !type.empty? &&\n                      rarity.is_a?(String) && !rarity.empty? &&\n                      cost_gp.is_a?(Integer)\n\n    {\n      slug: slug,\n      name: name,\n      type: type,\n      rarity: rarity,\n      cost_gp: cost_gp\n    }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_item\nend\n\n#   Persistence.db do |d|\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaigns }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_character(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_character(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_characters WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_event(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_events (id, campaign_id, kind, summary) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:id], campaign_id, unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT name, dm FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      name, dm = row\n\n      characters = d.execute(\n        'SELECT id, name, level, class FROM campaign_characters WHERE campaign_id = ? ORDER BY id',\n        campaign_id\n      ).map do |id, char_name, level, klass|\n        { 'id' => id, 'name' => char_name, 'level' => level, 'class' => klass }\n      end\n\n      log_count = d.get_first_value('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_events WHERE campaign_id = ?', campaign_id)\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => campaign_id,\n        'name' => name,\n        'dm' => dm,\n        'characters' => characters,\n        'log_count' => log_count\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_campaign(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    name = payload['name']\n    dm = payload['dm']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      dm.is_a?(String) && !dm.empty?\n\n    { id: id, name: name, dm: dm }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_campaign\n\n  def self.validate_character(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    name = payload['name']\n    level = payload['level']\n    klass = payload['class']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      name.is_a?(String) && !name.empty? &&\n                      level.is_a?(Integer) && level >= 1 && level <= 20 &&\n                      klass.is_a?(String) && !klass.empty?\n\n    { id: id, name: name, level: level, class: klass }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_character\n\n  def self.validate_event(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    kind = payload['kind']\n    summary = payload['summary']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      kind.is_a?(String) && !kind.empty? &&\n                      (summary.nil? || summary.is_a?(String))\n\n    { id: id, kind: kind, summary: summary }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_event\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Quests: campaign quest tracking\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Quests\n  VALID_STATUSES = %w[active completed blocked].freeze\n\n  def self.create(campaign_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    data = validate_quest(payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless data\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_quests WHERE id = ?', data[:id])\n      next [:conflict] if existing\n\n      d.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_quests (id, campaign_id, title, status, milestones_json, completed_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [data[:id], campaign_id, data[:title], data[:status], JSON.generate(data[:milestones]), JSON.generate(data[:completed])]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => data[:id],\n        'title' => data[:title],\n        'status' => data[:status],\n        'milestones_total' => data[:milestones].length,\n        'milestones_done' => 0\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.update_progress(campaign_id, quest_id, payload)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty? &&\n                           quest_id.is_a?(String) && !quest_id.empty?\n\n    completed = payload['completed']\n    return [:invalid] unless completed.is_a?(Array) && completed.all? { |m| m.is_a?(String) }\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      row = d.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT id, status, milestones_json, completed_json FROM campaign_quests WHERE id = ? AND campaign_id = ?',\n        [quest_id, campaign_id]\n      )\n      next [:not_found] unless row\n\n      _, status, milestones_json, completed_json = row\n      milestones = JSON.parse(milestones_json)\n      done = JSON.parse(completed_json)\n\n      completed.each do |m|\n        done << m if milestones.include?(m) && !done.include?(m)\n      end\n\n      milestones_done = milestones.count { |m| done.include?(m) }\n      new_status = (milestones_done == milestones.length && milestones.length > 0) ? 'completed' : status\n\n      d.execute(\n        'UPDATE campaign_quests SET status = ?, completed_json = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [new_status, JSON.generate(done), quest_id]\n      )\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'id' => quest_id,\n        'status' => new_status,\n        'milestones_total' => milestones.length,\n        'milestones_done' => milestones_done\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.summary(campaign_id)\n    return [:invalid] unless campaign_id.is_a?(String) && !campaign_id.empty?\n\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      campaign_exists = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?', campaign_id)\n      next [:not_found] unless campaign_exists\n\n      active = 0\n      completed = 0\n      blocked = 0\n\n      d.execute('SELECT status FROM campaign_quests WHERE campaign_id = ?', campaign_id).each do |status|\n        case status\n        when 'active' then active += 1\n        when 'completed' then completed += 1\n        when 'blocked' then blocked += 1\n        end\n      end\n\n      [:ok, {\n        'campaign_id' => campaign_id,\n        'active' => active,\n        'completed' => completed,\n        'blocked' => blocked\n      }]\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.validate_quest(payload)\n    return nil unless payload.is_a?(Hash)\n\n    id = payload['id']\n    title = payload['title']\n    status = payload['status']\n    milestones = payload['milestones']\n\n    return nil unless id.is_a?(String) && !id.empty? &&\n                      title.is_a?(String) && !title.empty? &&\n                      status.is_a?(String) && VALID_STATUSES.include?(status) &&\n                      milestones.is_a?(Array) &&\n                      milestones.all? { |m| m.is_a?(String) && !m.empty? }\n\n    {\n      id: id,\n      title: title,\n      status: status,\n      milestones: milestones,\n      completed: []\n    }\n  end\n  private_class_method :validate_quest\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Authentication (PBKDF2 password hashing)\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule Auth\n  VALID_ROLES = %w[dm player].freeze\n  USERNAME_RE = /\\A[a-z0-9_-]{2,32}\\z/.freeze\n  PBKDF2_ITERATIONS = 210_000\n  HASH_BYTES = 32\n  SALT_BYTES = 16\n\n  def self.valid_username?(username)\n    username.is_a?(String) && username.match?(USERNAME_RE)\n  end\n\n  def self.valid_password?(password)\n    password.is_a?(String) && password.bytesize >= 8\n  end\n\n  def self.valid_role?(role)\n    VALID_ROLES.include?(role)\n  end\n\n  def self.register_user(username, password, role)\n    creds = hash_password(password)\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      existing = d.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = ?', username)\n      next false if existing\n\n      d.execute('INSERT INTO users (username, role, salt, hash) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', [username, role, creds[:salt], creds[:hash]])\n      true\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.authenticate_user(username, password)\n    Persistence.db do |d|\n      row = d.get_first_row('SELECT salt, hash FROM users WHERE username = ?', username)\n      next false unless row\n\n      verify_password(password, row[0], row[1])\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.hash_password(password)\n    salt = SecureRandom.random_bytes(SALT_BYTES)\n    hash = OpenSSL::KDF.pbkdf2_hmac(\n      password,\n      salt: salt,\n      iterations: PBKDF2_ITERATIONS,\n      length: HASH_BYTES,\n      hash: 'sha256'\n    )\n    { salt: Base64.strict_encode64(salt), hash: Base64.strict_encode64(hash) }\n  end\n  private_class_method :hash_password\n\n  def self.verify_password(password, salt_b64, hash_b64)\n    salt = Base64.strict_decode64(salt_b64)\n    expected = Base64.strict_decode64(hash_b64)\n    actual = OpenSSL::KDF.pbkdf2_hmac(\n      password,\n      salt: salt,\n      iterations: PBKDF2_ITERATIONS,\n      length: expected.bytesize,\n      hash: 'sha256'\n    )\n    OpenSSL.secure_compare(actual, expected)\n  rescue StandardError\n    false\n  end\n  private_class_method :verify_password\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Player's Handbook rules\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule PlayerHandbook\n  WIZARD_SPELL_SLOTS = {\n    5 => { '1' => 4, '2' => 3, '3' => 2 }\n  }.freeze\n\n  def self.spell_slots(payload)\n    klass = payload['class']\n    level = payload['level']\n\n    return nil unless klass == 'wizard' && level.is_a?(Integer) && level == 5\n\n    slots = WIZARD_SPELL_SLOTS[level]\n    return nil unless slots\n\n    {\n      'class' => klass,\n      'level' => level,\n      'slots' => slots\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.long_rest(payload)\n    level = payload['level']\n    hp_current = payload['hp_current']\n    hp_max = payload['hp_max']\n    hit_dice_spent = payload['hit_dice_spent']\n    exhaustion_level = payload['exhaustion_level']\n\n    return nil unless level.is_a?(Integer) && level >= 1 &&\n                      hp_current.is_a?(Integer) &&\n                      hp_max.is_a?(Integer) && hp_max > 0 &&\n                      hit_dice_spent.is_a?(Integer) && hit_dice_spent >= 0 &&\n                      exhaustion_level.is_a?(Integer) && exhaustion_level >= 0\n\n    recovered = [level / 2, 1].max\n    new_hit_dice_spent = [hit_dice_spent - recovered, 0].max\n\n    {\n      'hp_current' => hp_max,\n      'hit_dice_spent' => new_hit_dice_spent,\n      'exhaustion_level' => [exhaustion_level - 1, 0].max\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.equipment_load(payload)\n    strength = payload['strength']\n    weight = payload['weight']\n\n    return nil unless strength.is_a?(Integer) && strength >= 1 &&\n                      weight.is_a?(Integer) && weight >= 0\n\n    capacity = strength * 15\n\n    {\n      'capacity' => capacity,\n      'weight' => weight,\n      'encumbered' => weight > capacity\n    }\n  end\nend\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Dungeon Master's toolbox\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nmodule DmTools\n
